changes.title: Station rows
items: The treehouse's dressing menus show every kind at once, stacked, with no tabs, floating over the room in a thin gold frame
The camera zooms in on what you're choosing: your face at the dressing table, your feet at the shoe rack
Your hat comes off at the dressing table so you can see your face and hair
Rows with nothing to choose yet stay hidden; the broom stand shows the classic broom until the Workshop

changes.title: House furniture
items: The treehouse's bedroom has its first real furniture: a gothic canopy bed, a clothes rail strung with lights, a bulb-lit vanity, and the crystal ball on its clawed stand (a first look; the rest are still boxes)

changes.title: Lake hold
items: Over a lake you can't drop out of the treetops any more: pressing to come down there does nothing but a soft "nope", and you fly on at full speed
